nirf_name: BABU BANARASI DAS NORTHERN INDIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY
description: Babu Banarasi Das Institute of Technology and Management (BBDITM), formerly Babu Banarasi Das National Institute of Technology and Management (BBDNITM), is an engineering and management institute in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. It is affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University and approved by AICTE.

agent_notes: The exact institution row was established in both NIRF 2025 Overall and Pharmacy listings as BABU BANARASI DAS NORTHERN INDIA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the managed proxy's self-signed certificate-chain error. curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected nirfindia.org, search-engine, and official-site hostnames.

The legacy official URL https://bbdnitm.ac.in/ redirects to https://bbditm.ac.in/. The official identity page states that BBDITM was formerly BBDNITM but spells the former name as National rather than the NIRF listing's Northern, so identity naming requires manual review.

The official catalogue is internally inconsistent: /btech/ lists a standalone Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) branch in addition to the branches on /admissions/, while /engineering/ lists a shorter branch set. The M.Tech page states 60% eligibility, whereas the central admissions page states 50% or 45% for SC/ST. These conflicts prevent a complete verified catalogue.

The official MBA page lists MBA (Professional) specializations, while the central admissions page labels the programme MBA. A historical BBA reference appears in the management narrative but is not listed in the current admissions/programme catalogue and was excluded. No active diploma, certificate, or doctoral programme was found on the current official catalogue pages.
